styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Ragù, tortellini and market grazing all day.

styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Porticoes, piazzas and the oldest university.

styles.label: Budget
styles.blurb: Cheap eats, free sights and walkable streets.

stays.why: Walk to Piazza Maggiore, the porticoes and most trattorias. Best for first-timers.
Next to the station for day trips to Florence or Modena; 15 minutes on foot to the centre.
Lively bars and cheap eats around Via Zamboni; good budget base, can be noisy at night.
Quieter residential area near the station and Porta Saragozza; good value, still walkable.

food: Order tagliatelle al ragù, not spaghetti bolognese; locals eat tortellini in brodo too.
Try a plate of mortadella and crescentine (fried dough) at a casual osteria.
The Quadrilatero market streets near Piazza Maggiore are good for a cheap grazing lunch.
Book dinner ahead on weekends; popular trattorias fill up fast.
Aperitivo around 18:00–19:00 often comes with snacks; check the price before ordering.
more_time: Day trip to Modena by train for balsamic and the food market; check times on the day.
Swap a museum morning for a walk up to San Luca under the long portico; check opening hours.
Take a train to Ferrara or Parma for a half-day of Renaissance streets and food.

recommend.why: Two nights covers the centre, the porticoes and a proper food day, with time for one day trip.

month_notes: January: cold, highs near 8°C, lows around 1°C. Pack a warm coat.
February: still cold, highs near 11°C, about 8 rain days.
March: mild at 15°C, mixed sun and showers.
April: pleasant at 19°C, but one of the wetter months.
May: warm at 22°C and the wettest month, around 13 rain days.
June: warm and drier, highs near 28°C.
July: hot, highs near 32°C; sightsee early and late.
August: hot and often quiet, highs near 31°C; some places close.
September: warm at 25°C, good all-round month.
October: mild at 20°C, about 9 rain days.
November: cooler at 13°C and wetter, around 10 rain days.
December: cold, highs near 9°C; festive lights in the centre.

climate_guide.summary: Four clear seasons: cold, damp winters and hot, humid summers, with the best weather in spring and autumn.

items.title: Best time: April to June and September to October
items.text: Mild days around 19–25°C, good for walking the porticoes.

items.title: July and August are hot
items.text: Highs near 31–32°C with warm nights. Plan indoor sights at midday.

items.title: Winter is cold and damp
items.text: January highs near 8°C and lows around 1°C. Bring a warm coat.

items.title: Rain in spring and autumn
items.text: May has the most rain days, around 13. Carry a small umbrella.

items.title: Summer is fairly dry
items.text: July and August see around 7–8 rain days, often short storms.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Comfortable walking shoes, layers, and a light rain jacket in spring and autumn.

transit.best: Walk the centre; use TPER buses for longer hops.

modes.text: No metro yet; a tram network is under construction.
TPER buses cover the city. Single ticket €2.30, valid 75 min; €2.50 on board. Day pass about €9. Buy at tabacchi or newsstands.
Taxis are metered. Uber is limited; local apps work better.
Driving in the centre is restricted; cars are banned in parts during the day.
Walking is easy and pleasant. Bike hire is cheap, about €1–2 per 15 min.
